effect.name: Faixas Lineares
effect.desc: Cria listras em forma de linha, deslizando a camada em um ângulo e combinando pixels sobrepostos (o Linear Streaks do Alight Motion).
effect.desc-en: Creates line-shaped streaks by sliding the layer along an angle and combining overlapping pixels (Alight Motion's Linear Streaks).
